atoms.exact_source_text: Authored framing and Focus are distinct.
atoms.normalized_claim: Authored framing and Focus are distinct concepts.

atoms.exact_source_text: Framing identifies what or whose history the entire MEET concerns
atoms.normalized_claim: Framing identifies what or whose history the entire MEET concerns.

atoms.exact_source_text: Focus identifies whom the current Turn follows.
atoms.normalized_claim: Focus identifies whom the current Turn follows.

atoms.exact_source_text: Framing persists, but it never restricts the player's valid mechanical options.
atoms.normalized_claim: Framing persists but never restricts the player's valid mechanical options.

atoms.exact_source_text: A scene may be about Bracken while a selected Tool makes Snip the Citizen through whom one Turn is resolved.
atoms.normalized_claim: Example: a scene may be about Bracken while a selected Tool makes Snip the Citizen through whom one Turn is resolved.

atoms.exact_source_text: UI signaling remains restrained: a brief note such as “Twig takes focus - Sire’s Hat” or “Preserved - Hazel’s Brass Button” may appear when needed.
atoms.normalized_claim: UI signaling for Focus remains restrained, e.g. a brief note such as "Twig takes focus - Sire's Hat" or "Preserved - Hazel's Brass Button" may appear when needed.

atoms.exact_source_text: There is no persistent Focus badge, meter, portrait frame, sound cue, history counter, or formal title.
atoms.normalized_claim: There is no persistent Focus badge, meter, portrait frame, sound cue, history counter, or formal title.

atoms.exact_source_text: The Launch MEET begins the road toward Away but does not achieve departure until executed.
atoms.normalized_claim: The Launch MEET begins the road toward Away but does not achieve departure until executed.

atoms.exact_source_text: Launch receives each Citizen as they already are
atoms.normalized_claim: Launch receives each Citizen as they already are.

atoms.exact_source_text: its personal-item choice is Supply preparation.
atoms.normalized_claim: Launch's personal-item choice is Supply preparation.

atoms.exact_source_text: Each proposed party member displays their equipped Tool and Keepsake read-only.
atoms.normalized_claim: Each proposed party member displays their equipped Tool and Keepsake read-only in the Launch interface.

atoms.exact_source_text: The player clicks a Citizen's Supply box to open the current Colony prepared-Supply pool.
atoms.normalized_claim: The player clicks a Citizen's Supply box to open the current Colony prepared-Supply pool.

atoms.exact_source_text: Selecting a Supply places it in that box and immediately removes it from the pool display.
atoms.normalized_claim: Selecting a Supply places it in that box and immediately removes it from the pool display.

atoms.exact_source_text: Removing or replacing an assigned Supply updates the pool immediately.
atoms.normalized_claim: Removing or replacing an assigned Supply updates the pool immediately.

atoms.exact_source_text: Removing a Citizen from the proposed party automatically returns that Citizen's Supply to the pool.
atoms.normalized_claim: Removing a Citizen from the proposed party automatically returns that Citizen's Supply to the pool.

atoms.exact_source_text: Tool reassignment is not a top-level Launch function.
atoms.normalized_claim: Tool reassignment is not a top-level Launch function.

atoms.exact_source_text: The player may cancel the unexecuted Launch, change the Tool in Citizen View, and begin Launch again.
atoms.normalized_claim: The player may cancel the unexecuted Launch, change the Tool in Citizen View, and begin Launch again.

atoms.exact_source_text: Before execution, party membership and Supply assignments remain editable.
atoms.normalized_claim: Before execution, party membership and Supply assignments remain editable.

atoms.exact_source_text: Executing Launch fixes party membership and all Tool, Keepsake, and Supply assignments under Away rules.
atoms.normalized_claim: Executing Launch fixes party membership and all Tool, Keepsake, and Supply assignments under Away rules.

atoms.exact_source_text: Cancelling an unexecuted Launch returns all assigned Supplies to the Colony pool, clears the proposed party and Supply boxes, and stores no draft loadout or Campaign Memory event.
atoms.normalized_claim: Cancelling an unexecuted Launch returns all assigned Supplies to the Colony pool, clears the proposed party and Supply boxes, and stores no draft loadout or Campaign Memory event.
